aub_upgrade_chain_longhouses_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = longhouses_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_longhouses_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = tribal_building_tier_2_cost }
			scope:aub_payer = { prestige >= expensive_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
		upgrade_building_effect = longhouses_01
		if = {
			limit = { has_building = longhouses_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_prestige_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = tribal_building_tier_2_cost PRESTIGE = expensive_building_tier_2_cost }
		}
	}
}

aub_upgrade_chain_mali_mines_01_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = mali_mines_01
			aub_can_upgrade_to_mali_mines_02_trigger = yes
			aub_can_pay_gold_building_cost_trigger = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		remove_building = mali_mines_01
		scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
		add_special_building = mali_mines_02

			limit = { has_building = mali_mines_02 }
			aub_pay_gold_building_cost_effect = { GOLD = expensive_building_tier_4_cost }
		}
		else = {
			scope:aub_payer = { save_scope_as = character }
			add_special_building = mali_mines_01
		}

		}

	else_if = {
